label: Constitutive population from a concrete organization and the q44 own-being giver
summary: After 0719304b's conditional local delivery result, tested a whole that selects population without admitting only populated states. Three pairwise sum linkages on binary stops force one or three displaced springs and allow the sole load at any contact. Reversing one linkage permits total relaxation. Requiring each bottom relay's activity to agree with its contact load alongside effective supplier-only transmission admits a state iff one entire channel is intact. An active channel has a distinct actual neighbour at every stage on the existing tailAtState profile even with OwnBeing assigned nowhere among stages. The model excludes neither an additional giver outside its carrier nor a concrete whole that supplies its members. An instantiated material mechanism gives independent meaning to the load through spring deformation and restoring force. Its parts survive unloading, so that mechanism explains an exercise without explaining those bearers' esse. A cut casting supplies a separate individuation case: continuity of the remaining actual metal determines whether one or two pieces exist. The prior material and the existence of pieces considered apart from separation still require their own account. A more fundamental whole could constitute its members as determinations of itself. For the same whole to qualify under q44 requires distinctness from each participant, own subsistent esse, and an actual whole-to-member esse cause in the selected meaning. See docs/notes/q44-inferential-dependency.md#can-the-organization-of-a-whole-explain-why-any-supplier-is-active and the linked local Lean diagnostic. No registered consequence or change of formal premise.
blocker: For a particular actual participant, independently identify the whole and show how it individuates and constitutes the bearer itself, or identify the received productive contribution to the bearer's esse along its complete supplier cone. Necessity of a conditional structural constraint does not establish necessary instantiation of this whole. An exercised causal role and OwnBeing at the very same giver remain indispensable on the productive q44 reading.
